arxiv-2312-08284.title: Unconventional correlated metallic behavior due to interorbital Coulomb interaction
arxiv-2312-08284.creator: N. Aucar Boidi, A. P. Kampf, K. Hallberg
arxiv-2312-08284.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by N. Aucar Boidi, A. P. Kampf, K. Hallberg. We study the non-degenerate one dimensional two-orbital Hubbard model with interorbital Coulomb interaction. By means of the density-matrix renormalization group technique, we calculate the local single-particle density of states and the optical conductivity at zero temperature. We find that a finite interorbital Coulomb repulsion V V generates a new class of states within the Mott-Hubbard band which has a large weight of holon-doublon pairs, which we hence call the holon-doublon band (HDB).

arxiv-2408-07672.description: Abstract Holographic light potentials generated by phase-modulating liquid-crystal spatial light modulators (SLMs) are widely used in quantum technology applications. arxiv-2506-00537.title: Huntsman may need to be irradiated
arxiv-2506-00537.creator: Shunyi Lan, \altemailmark \orcid 0009-0001-8816-8523 Xiangcun Meng, \altemailmark \orcid 0000-0001-5316-2298
arxiv-2506-00537.description: Abstract Millisecond pulsars are rapidly rotating neutron stars, and it is now widely accepted that their extremely short rotation periods result from the accretion of material from a companion star. Binary evolution theory predicts that millisecond pulsars can have various types of companion stars. However, in observations, binary pulsars with giant companions, referred to as “huntsman pulsars”, are extremely rare.

arxiv-2506-20636.description: Abstract Accurate extrinsic calibration between LiDAR and camera sensors is important for reliable perception in autonomous systems. In this paper, we present a novel multi-objective optimization framework that jointly minimizes the geometric alignment error and computational cost associated with camera-LiDAR calibration.

arxiv-2507-06637.creator: Pengcheng Zeng, Siyuan Jiang
arxiv-2507-06637.description: Abstract We propose Path Signatures Logistic Regression (PSLR), a semi-parametric framework for classifying vector-valued functional data with scalar covariates. Classical functional logistic regression models rely on linear assumptions and fixed basis expansions, which limit flexibility and degrade performance under irregular sampling.

pmc-12641890.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Permethrin (PERM) is a synthetic pyrethroid insecticide initially regarded as low risk. However, evidence now indicates that misuse and prolonged exposure can damage multiple physiological systems by disrupting enzymatic functions in subcellular structures. In this study, male Wistar rats were administered PERM (75, 150, or 300 mg/kg/day) for 15 days to assess its effect on hematological and biochemical parameters, including oxidative stress markers in the liver, kidney, and heart. Subacute PERM administration induced significant, dose-dependent toxicological alterations in exposed animals.

uslaw-usc-t11-s1165.title: 11 U.S.C. § 1165 — Protection of the public interest
uslaw-usc-t11-s1165.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t11-s1165.description: United States Code, Title 11 (Bankruptcy); Chapter 11 (Reorganization); Subchapter IV (Railroad Reorganization). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. In applying sections 1166, 1167, 1169, 1170, 1171, 1172, 1173, and 1174 of this title, the court and the trustee shall consider the public interest in addition to the interests of the debtor, creditors, and equity security holders.
